summary: Read the packaged model-specific original species deck into a fresh numeric array.

identity.direction: Declared inputs to named scientific outputs.
identity.definition: No hidden source-checkout read. The deck is a declared scientific fixture with model-specific columns and units; calling the data accessor does not validate a physical application.
identity.model: Nonrelativistic Gaussian species; explicit finite-harmonic/rational approximation when applicable.
identity.geometry: Homogeneous plasma with background field along z; k=(kx,0,kz) where applicable.
identity.coordinates: Explicit ES dimensionless normalization or EM SI; complex frequency follows exp(-i omega t).
identity.boundary: Periodic/infinite homogeneous plane-wave response; finite numerical harmonic/pole representation explicitly declared.
assumptions: A numerical spectrum is not automatically a physically certified mode.

outputs.name: deck
outputs.description: Fresh species array with explicit model-specific legacy unit convention.
outputs.units: ES dimensionless; EM q/e,m/me,n m^-3,T eV,vd/c
outputs.constraints: Finite and representable in the declared numeric type.

preconditions: Constituent inputs finite and representable in declared numeric ports.
excluded: No automatic claim that the default fixture describes a user experiment.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for unknown model; packaged table read/parse errors propagate.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Packaged file I/O errors propagate; no the reference runtime process or native receipt.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not an iterative or eigensolve operation.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No successful result is returned if this operation raises; no partial scientific return is promised.

example.description: Bounded executable use of the actual declared scientific ports.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.dispersion.rational import default_deck
deck = default_deck('es1d')
assert deck.ndim == 2 and deck.shape[1] == 5
example.expected: The helper returned a fresh float64 ES1D deck of shape (2,5): [[-1,1,0.9,1,0],[-1,1,0.1,1,7.071]].

scope: Current SciRel implementation and the repository tests listed in this contract cover the declared public ports and numerical relation.
The example exercises one bounded representative case; it does not extend applicability beyond the declared preconditions.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct tests and the bounded example establish only the declared input/output behavior, numerical checks and failure boundaries; they do not establish arbitrary-parameter parity, branch uniqueness, global physical validity, human scientific endorsement or release approval.
known_limitations: Original license unverified; MATLAB execution NOT_RUN.
Finite-J/finite-N physics must be qualified for a new requested regime.
Earlier fixed-distance approach-to-axis ancillary assertions remain failed records; exact-axis/direct-response gates are separately qualified.
Human scientific and plot approval pending.
Example output is a bounded runtime observation, not a universal scientific claim.

references: Xie and Xiao, PDRK: A General Kinetic Dispersion Relation Solver for Magnetized Plasma, Plasma Science and Technology 18 (2016).
